paheli.question: I am never sick, yet I swallow bullets. Both kids and elders get scared hearing my loud voice. Tell me, what am I?

dialogue: Teacher: Ramu, tell me how many countries are there in the world?
Ramu: Madam, what a childish question! There is only one country in the world, 'India', all the rest are 'foreign'!

prerak_kahani.title: The Chain of Thought (The Elephant's Rope)
prerak_kahani.story: A man noticed that huge elephants were being held back by only a small rope tied to their front leg. He asked the trainer why these powerful elephants didn't just break the rope and escape. The trainer replied, 'When they were very young, we used the same size rope to tie them. At that age, they couldn't break it. As they grew up, they were conditioned to believe they could never break the rope. Because they believe the rope can still hold them, they never try to break free.'
prerak_kahani.moral: Believe in your capabilities. Just because you failed at something once before, doesn't mean you will fail again. Never give up trying.

word_of_the_day.meaning: Firm determination (making a strong decision)
word_of_the_day.example: I have made a resolution to secure the first position in the exam.

today_in_history.fact: On September 1, 1956, the Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) was established.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? Real honey is the only food that never spoils, even after thousands of years.

quote_of_the_day.quote: Education is the most powerful weapon which you can use to change the world.
quote_of_the_day.author: Nelson Mandela

paheli.question: I speak without a mouth and hear without ears. I have no body, but I come alive with wind. What am I?

dialogue: Son: Dad, can you write in the dark?
Father: I think so. What do you want me to write?
Son: Your signature on this report card.

prerak_kahani.title: The Value of Time
prerak_kahani.story: A rich businessman missed a flight that ended up crashing. Shaken, he realized that all his wealth couldn't buy him a single extra second of life if his time was up. He stopped working 16-hour days and started spending time with his family, realizing time was his only true non-renewable resource.
prerak_kahani.moral: Time is more valuable than money. You can get more money, but you cannot get more time.

word_of_the_day.meaning: Able to withstand or recover quickly from difficult conditions.
word_of_the_day.example: Despite the harsh winter, the resilient plant bloomed in the spring.

today_in_history.fact: On September 2, 1945, World War II officially ended with the formal surrender of Japan aboard the USS Missouri.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? Octopuses have three hearts, nine brains, and blue blood.

quote_of_the_day.quote: Be the change that you wish to see in the world.
quote_of_the_day.author: Mahatma Gandhi

paheli.question: I am tall when I'm young, and I'm short when I'm old. What am I?

dialogue: Patient: Doctor, I feel like I'm a pair of curtains!
Doctor: Well, pull yourself together!

prerak_kahani.title: The Group of Frogs
prerak_kahani.story: Two frogs fell into a deep pit. The other frogs gathered around and told them it was impossible to jump out. One frog gave up and died. The other kept jumping harder and finally made it out. When he got out, the others asked, 'Did you not hear us?' The frog explained he was deaf and thought they were encouraging him the entire time.
prerak_kahani.moral: There is power in words. Ignore negative people and focus on your goals.

word_of_the_day.meaning: The ability to understand and share the feelings of another.
word_of_the_day.example: He showed great empathy towards the flood victims.

today_in_history.fact: On September 3, 1971, Qatar officially gained its independence from the United Kingdom.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? Bananas are technically berries, but strawberries are not.

quote_of_the_day.quote: The only way to do great work is to love what you do.
quote_of_the_day.author: Steve Jobs

paheli.question: I have keys but no locks. I have a space but no room. You can enter, but can't go outside. What am I?

dialogue: Wife: Honey, do I look fat in this dress?
Husband: No, you just look like you are easy to see.

prerak_kahani.title: The Two Wolves
prerak_kahani.story: An old Cherokee chief was teaching his grandson about life. 'A fight is going on inside me,' he said. 'It is a terrible fight between two wolves. One is evil - he is anger, envy, sorrow, regret, and ego. The other is good - he is joy, peace, love, hope, and kindness. This same fight is going on inside you.' The grandson asked, 'Which wolf will win?' The chief replied, 'The one you feed.'
prerak_kahani.moral: We have both good and bad qualities within us. Our character is determined by which qualities we choose to nurture.

word_of_the_day.meaning: Sympathetic pity and concern for the sufferings or misfortunes of others.
word_of_the_day.example: The doctors treated the injured animals with immense compassion.

today_in_history.fact: On September 4, 1998, Google was officially incorporated as a company by Larry Page and Sergey Brin.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? Wombat poop is cube-shaped. It helps them stack their droppings to mark their territory without it rolling away.

quote_of_the_day.quote: Imagination is more important than knowledge. Knowledge is limited; imagination encircles the world.
quote_of_the_day.author: Albert Einstein

paheli.question: I have branches, but no fruit, trunk, or leaves. What am I?

dialogue: Teacher: Why are you late to school today?
Student: Because of a sign down the road, sir.
Teacher: What does a sign have to do with you being late?
Student: It said, 'School Ahead, Go Slow!'

prerak_kahani.title: The Empty Cup
prerak_kahani.story: A learned professor visited a Zen master to ask about Zen. The master served tea. He poured his visitor's cup full, and then kept on pouring. The professor watched until he could no longer restrain himself. 'It is overfull. No more will go in!' he cried. 'Like this cup,' the master said, 'you are full of your own opinions and speculations. How can I show you Zen unless you first empty your cup?'
prerak_kahani.moral: To learn something new, you must first keep an open mind and be willing to let go of your preconceived notions.

word_of_the_day.meaning: The quality of being thankful; readiness to show appreciation for and to return kindness.
word_of_the_day.example: She expressed deep gratitude to everyone who helped her during hard times.

today_in_history.fact: On September 5, India celebrates Teachers' Day in honor of the birth anniversary of Dr. Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? Sloths can hold their breath for up to 40 minutes, which is longer than dolphins.

quote_of_the_day.quote: True teachers are those who help us think for ourselves.
quote_of_the_day.author: Dr. Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan

paheli.question: What has words, but never speaks?

dialogue: Friend 1: Why did you put your smartphone in the refrigerator?
Friend 2: Because I wanted to listen to some cool music!

prerak_kahani.title: The Ant and the Grasshopper
prerak_kahani.story: During the summer, an ant worked hard gathering food while a grasshopper played music and rested. The grasshopper laughed at the ant for working so hard. When winter came, the ant had plenty of food stored up, but the grasshopper was starving. The ant shared a little bit of food but told the grasshopper that he needed to prepare better next time.
prerak_kahani.moral: Work hard today so you can be prepared for the challenges of tomorrow.

word_of_the_day.meaning: Hopefulness and confidence about the future or the successful outcome of something.
word_of_the_day.example: Despite the setbacks, the team maintained a sense of optimism.

today_in_history.fact: On September 6, 1522, the Victoria, one of the surviving ships of Ferdinand Magellan's expedition, returned to Spain, completing the first circumnavigation of the globe.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? A single strand of spaghetti is technically called a 'spaghetto'.

quote_of_the_day.quote: All our dreams can come true, if we have the courage to pursue them.
quote_of_the_day.author: Walt Disney

paheli.question: The more of this there is, the less you see. What is it?

dialogue: Boss: Do you believe in life after death?
Employee: Yes, sir.
Boss: Good. Because after you left early yesterday to go to your grandmother's funeral, she stopped by the office to see you.

prerak_kahani.title: The Lion and the Mouse
prerak_kahani.story: A sleeping lion was awakened by a mouse running over his face. The lion caught the mouse and was about to eat him. The mouse begged for forgiveness, promising to repay the favor one day. The lion laughed at the idea but let him go. Weeks later, the lion was caught in a hunter's net. The mouse heard his roars, rushed over, and gnawed through the ropes, freeing the mighty lion.
prerak_kahani.moral: No act of kindness, no matter how small, is ever wasted. Even the smallest friend can be a great help.

word_of_the_day.meaning: Persistence in doing something despite difficulty or delay in achieving success.
word_of_the_day.example: His perseverance finally paid off when he won the championship.

today_in_history.fact: On September 7, 1923, the International Criminal Police Organization, widely known as INTERPOL, was founded in Vienna, Austria.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? A single day on Venus is longer than a whole year on Venus. It takes Venus longer to rotate once on its axis than to complete one orbit of the Sun.

quote_of_the_day.quote: Optimism is the faith that leads to achievement. Nothing can be done without hope and confidence.
quote_of_the_day.author: Helen Keller

paheli.question: I follow you all the time and copy your every move, but you can't touch me or catch me. What am I?

dialogue: Patient: Doctor, will I be able to play the piano after the operation?
Doctor: Yes, of course.
Patient: Great! I never knew how to play it before!

prerak_kahani.title: The Farmer and the Stork
prerak_kahani.story: A farmer placed nets on his newly sown field to catch the cranes that were eating his seeds. When he returned, he found a stork caught in the nets along with the cranes. The stork pleaded, 'Please let me go! I am a stork, a bird of excellent character. Look at my feathers, they are not like the cranes.' The farmer replied, 'You may be a good bird, but I caught you with the thieves, so you must share their punishment.'
prerak_kahani.moral: You are judged by the company you keep. Associate with good people to avoid trouble.

word_of_the_day.meaning: The quality of being honest and having strong moral principles.
word_of_the_day.example: The manager was respected by all her employees because of her absolute integrity.

today_in_history.fact: September 8 is celebrated globally as International Literacy Day, established by UNESCO in 1966.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? Humans are the only animals in the world known to blush.

quote_of_the_day.quote: One child, one teacher, one book, one pen can change the world.
quote_of_the_day.author: Malala Yousafzai

paheli.question: What goes up but never comes down?

dialogue: Customer: Waiter, there is a fly in my soup!
Waiter: Don't worry, sir. The spider in your salad will get it.

prerak_kahani.title: The Golden Egg
prerak_kahani.story: A farmer possessed a wonderful goose that laid a glittering golden egg every single day. The farmer grew incredibly rich, but as he grew rich, he also grew greedy. He thought, 'If this bird lays golden eggs, its inside must be made of solid gold!' Thinking he could get all the gold at once, he killed the goose and cut it open. To his dismay, it was just like any other goose, and he lost his daily source of wealth.
prerak_kahani.moral: Think before you act. Greed often destroys the source of good fortune.

word_of_the_day.meaning: The desire to promote the welfare of others, expressed especially by the generous donation of money to good causes.
word_of_the_day.example: The wealthy industrialist was known for his philanthropy, funding several schools and hospitals.

today_in_history.fact: On September 9, 2015, Queen Elizabeth II became the longest-reigning British monarch, surpassing Queen Victoria.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? Cows have best friends and get highly stressed when they are separated from them.

quote_of_the_day.quote: Yesterday I was clever, so I wanted to change the world. Today I am wise, so I am changing myself.
quote_of_the_day.author: Rumi

paheli.question: I have cities, but no houses. I have mountains, but no trees. I have water, but no fish. What am I?

dialogue: Father: Why did you get such a low score in the exam?
Son: Because of absence!
Father: You were absent on the day of the exam?
Son: No, the boy sitting next to me was absent!

prerak_kahani.title: The Tortoise and the Hare
prerak_kahani.story: A fast hare was always bragging about his speed and mocking a slow tortoise. Tired of the boasting, the tortoise challenged him to a race. The hare quickly darted ahead and, seeing he was so far in front, decided to take a nap under a tree. The tortoise just kept walking, slowly but steadily. When the hare finally woke up, he saw the tortoise crossing the finish line and realized he had lost.
prerak_kahani.moral: Slow and steady wins the race. Consistency and determination matter more than just natural ability.

word_of_the_day.meaning: The ability to do something that frightens one; bravery.
word_of_the_day.example: It takes a lot of courage to stand up for what is right when everyone else is quiet.

today_in_history.fact: On September 10, 2008, the Large Hadron Collider (LHC), the world's largest and most powerful particle accelerator, was powered up in Geneva, Switzerland.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? A snail can sleep for three years at a time.

quote_of_the_day.quote: Success is not final, failure is not fatal: it is the courage to continue that counts.
quote_of_the_day.author: Winston Churchill

paheli.question: I have lots of holes, but I can hold water. What am I?

dialogue: Teacher: Why does the math book always look so sad?
Student: Because it has so many problems!

prerak_kahani.title: The Giving Tree
prerak_kahani.story: A boy loved playing around an apple tree. As he grew, he asked the tree for money, so the tree gave him its apples to sell. Later, he wanted a house, so the tree gave him its branches to build one. Years later, he wanted a boat, and the tree gave him its trunk. Finally, as an old man, he just needed a place to rest, and the tree gladly offered its stump.
prerak_kahani.moral: True love is selfless. We should appreciate the unconditional love our parents and nature give us.

word_of_the_day.meaning: Careful and persistent work or effort.
word_of_the_day.example: His diligence in his studies resulted in excellent grades.

today_in_history.fact: On September 11, 1893, Swami Vivekananda delivered his famous speech at the Parliament of the World's Religions in Chicago, introducing Hinduism to North America.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? Honeybees can recognize human faces.

quote_of_the_day.quote: The journey of a thousand miles begins with one step.
quote_of_the_day.author: Lao Tzu

paheli.question: It belongs to you, but other people use it more than you do. What is it?

dialogue: Friend 1: Why did the two tomatoes fail to cross the road?
Friend 2: I don't know, why?
Friend 1: Because one got squashed, and the other said, 'Catch up!'

prerak_kahani.title: The Bundle of Sticks
prerak_kahani.story: An old man had three sons who constantly fought with each other. To teach them a lesson, he gave them a bundle of sticks and asked them to break it. None of them could. Then, he untied the bundle and gave them one stick each, which they broke easily. The father said, 'Like these sticks, if you stay united, no one can break you. But if you fight and separate, you will easily fall.'
prerak_kahani.moral: Unity is strength.

word_of_the_day.meaning: The quality of forming a pleasing and consistent whole; peaceful coexistence.
word_of_the_day.example: People of different cultures live in perfect harmony in this city.

today_in_history.fact: On September 12, 1959, the Soviet Union launched Luna 2, the first spacecraft to reach the surface of the Moon.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? Under certain conditions, hot water freezes faster than cold water. This is known as the Mpemba effect.

quote_of_the_day.quote: In the middle of difficulty lies opportunity.
quote_of_the_day.author: Albert Einstein

paheli.question: What gets wetter and wetter the more it dries?

dialogue: Student 1: Why don't scientists trust atoms?
Student 2: Why?
Student 1: Because they make up everything!

prerak_kahani.title: The Fox and the Grapes
prerak_kahani.story: A hungry fox saw some delicious-looking grapes hanging high on a vine. He jumped and jumped to reach them, but they were too high. Exhausted and unable to get a single grape, the fox walked away muttering, 'They were probably sour anyway.'
prerak_kahani.moral: It is easy to despise what you cannot have. Don't make excuses for your failures.

word_of_the_day.meaning: The belief in or practice of disinterested and selfless concern for the well-being of others.
word_of_the_day.example: Many charitable organizations are built on the altruism of their volunteers.

today_in_history.fact: On September 13, 1985, the iconic video game 'Super Mario Bros.' was released by Nintendo in Japan.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? A day on Mercury lasts 176 Earth days.

quote_of_the_day.quote: It always seems impossible until it's done.
quote_of_the_day.author: Nelson Mandela

paheli.question: I shave every day, but my beard stays exactly the same. Who am I?

dialogue: Son: Dad, why did the bicycle fall over?
Dad: I don't know, son. Why?
Son: Because it was two-tired!

prerak_kahani.title: The Thirsty Crow
prerak_kahani.story: On a hot summer day, a thirsty crow found a pitcher with a little water at the bottom. His beak couldn't reach it. Instead of giving up, he picked up pebbles one by one and dropped them into the pitcher. Gradually, the water level rose until it reached the top. The clever crow drank the water and flew away happily.
prerak_kahani.moral: Necessity is the mother of invention. Where there is a will, there is a way.

word_of_the_day.meaning: The capacity to accept or tolerate delay, trouble, or suffering without getting angry or upset.
word_of_the_day.example: Learning a new language requires a lot of patience.

today_in_history.fact: September 14 is celebrated as Hindi Diwas in India, marking the day in 1949 when Hindi was adopted as one of the official languages of the Republic of India.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? Peanuts are not technically nuts; they are legumes, related to beans and lentils.

quote_of_the_day.quote: Knowledge is power.
quote_of_the_day.author: Sir Francis Bacon

paheli.question: What has to be broken before you can use it?

dialogue: Patient: Doctor, I swallowed a clock yesterday!
Doctor: Well, how are you feeling?
Patient: Very alarmed! It's very time-consuming.

prerak_kahani.title: The Boy Who Cried Wolf
prerak_kahani.story: A shepherd boy used to trick the villagers by shouting 'Wolf! Wolf!' when there was no wolf. The villagers would rush to help him, only to find he was lying. One day, a real wolf appeared. The boy screamed for help, but the villagers, thinking it was another trick, ignored him. The wolf attacked his flock.
prerak_kahani.moral: Liars are not believed even when they speak the truth.

word_of_the_day.meaning: The action or process of inventing new ideas, methods, or products.
word_of_the_day.example: The tech industry thrives on continuous innovation.

today_in_history.fact: September 15 is celebrated as Engineer's Day in India in honor of the great engineer Sir M. Visvesvaraya.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? Apples float in water because 25% of their volume is made of air.

quote_of_the_day.quote: The best way to predict your future is to create it.
quote_of_the_day.author: Abraham Lincoln

paheli.question: I have hands, but I cannot clap. What am I?

dialogue: Customer: What do you call a fake noodle?
Chef: I have no idea.
Customer: An impasta!

prerak_kahani.title: The Dog and His Reflection
prerak_kahani.story: A dog found a piece of meat and was carrying it home in his mouth. As he crossed a bridge over a stream, he saw his own reflection in the water. Thinking it was another dog with an even bigger piece of meat, he opened his mouth to grab it. His meat fell into the stream and was washed away, leaving him with nothing.
prerak_kahani.moral: Greed can lead you to lose what you already have. Be content with your lot.

word_of_the_day.meaning: Cautiousness and practical wisdom in making decisions.
word_of_the_day.example: Saving a portion of your salary every month is a sign of financial prudence.

today_in_history.fact: September 16 is the International Day for the Preservation of the Ozone Layer, commemorating the 1987 signing of the Montreal Protocol.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? A crocodile cannot stick its tongue out because it is attached to the roof of its mouth.

quote_of_the_day.quote: Do what you can, with what you have, where you are.
quote_of_the_day.author: Theodore Roosevelt

paheli.question: What starts with a T, ends with a T, and is full of T?

dialogue: Kid 1: Why are ghosts such terrible liars?
Kid 2: Why?
Kid 1: Because you can see right through them!

prerak_kahani.title: The Crow and the Peacock
prerak_kahani.story: A crow was unhappy with his dark feathers and wished he looked like a peacock. He found some discarded peacock feathers, stuck them in his tail, and tried to join a flock of peacocks. The peacocks saw through his disguise and pecked him away. When he returned to the other crows, they rejected him too, saying he should have been proud of who he was.
prerak_kahani.moral: Accept yourself the way you are. Trying to be someone else will only bring you sorrow.

word_of_the_day.meaning: Of undisputed origin; genuine.
word_of_the_day.example: The museum displays authentic artifacts from the ancient Indus Valley Civilization.

today_in_history.fact: On September 17, 1950, Narendra Modi, who would become the 14th Prime Minister of India, was born in Gujarat.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? Butterflies taste their food with their feet.

quote_of_the_day.quote: Happiness is not something ready made. It comes from your own actions.
quote_of_the_day.author: Dalai Lama

paheli.question: What goes up and down but never actually moves?

dialogue: Patient: What do you call a bear with no teeth?
Dentist: I give up. What?
Patient: A gummy bear!

prerak_kahani.title: The Fox and the Stork
prerak_kahani.story: A mischievous fox invited a stork for dinner and served soup in a very shallow dish. The fox lapped it up easily, but the stork couldn't drink with her long beak. The next day, the stork invited the fox over and served the meal in a tall, narrow jar. The stork ate easily, while the fox couldn't fit his snout inside, leaving him hungry and humiliated.
prerak_kahani.moral: Treat others the way you want to be treated. Do not play tricks on others unless you can endure the same treatment.

word_of_the_day.meaning: The quality or fact of being very determined; determination.
word_of_the_day.example: Her extreme tenacity helped her finish the marathon despite an injured ankle.

today_in_history.fact: On September 18, 1851, the very first edition of The New York Times was published.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? A shrimp's heart is located inside its head.

quote_of_the_day.quote: We may encounter many defeats but we must not be defeated.
quote_of_the_day.author: Maya Angelou

paheli.question: I am an odd number. Take away a letter and I become even. What number am I?

dialogue: Farmer 1: Why did the scarecrow win an award?
Farmer 2: Why?
Farmer 1: Because he was outstanding in his field!

prerak_kahani.title: The Ant and the Dove
prerak_kahani.story: A thirsty ant fell into a river and was being carried away. A dove sitting on a nearby tree plucked a leaf and dropped it near the ant. The ant climbed on and was saved. Days later, a hunter aimed his arrow at the dove. The ant bit the hunter's heel, making him miss his shot, and saved the dove's life.
prerak_kahani.moral: One good turn deserves another. Kindness is always rewarded.

word_of_the_day.meaning: The quality of being well meaning; kindness.
word_of_the_day.example: He was known for his extreme benevolence towards the homeless.

today_in_history.fact: On September 19, 1893, New Zealand became the first country in the world to grant women the right to vote.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? Elephants are the only mammals that are physically incapable of jumping.

quote_of_the_day.quote: The only limit to our realization of tomorrow will be our doubts of today.
quote_of_the_day.author: Franklin D. Roosevelt

paheli.question: What has many teeth, but cannot bite?

dialogue: Boy: How does the ocean say hello?
Girl: I don't know.
Boy: It waves!

prerak_kahani.title: The Wind and the Sun
prerak_kahani.story: The Wind and the Sun were arguing about who was stronger. They saw a traveler wearing a coat and agreed that whoever could make him take it off was the strongest. The Wind blew fiercely, but the traveler just wrapped his coat tighter. Then, the Sun shined warmly and brightly. Soon, the traveler felt hot and took off his coat.
prerak_kahani.moral: Gentleness and persuasion are often much more effective than force and aggression.

word_of_the_day.meaning: Having or displaying a friendly and pleasant manner.
word_of_the_day.example: She had an amiable personality, which made her popular in the office.

today_in_history.fact: On September 20, 1857, British troops successfully recaptured Delhi, marking a turning point in the Indian Rebellion (Sepoy Mutiny).

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? Hippos secrete a reddish substance that acts as sunscreen, which is why people often mistakenly believe they sweat blood.

quote_of_the_day.quote: Fall seven times and stand up eight.
quote_of_the_day.author: Japanese Proverb

paheli.question: I am light as a feather, yet the strongest person can't hold me for five minutes. What am I?

dialogue: Customer: Why did the computer go to the doctor?
Technician: I'm not sure. Why?
Customer: Because it had a virus!

prerak_kahani.title: The Honest Woodcutter
prerak_kahani.story: A poor woodcutter accidentally dropped his iron axe into a deep river. The River Goddess appeared, offering him a golden axe, but he refused, saying it wasn't his. She then offered a silver axe, which he also declined. Finally, she brought up his iron axe, which he happily claimed. Impressed by his honesty, the Goddess gave him all three axes.
prerak_kahani.moral: Honesty is the best policy and always brings its own reward.

word_of_the_day.meaning: Conformity to facts; accuracy and strict honesty.
word_of_the_day.example: Officials expressed doubts concerning the veracity of the suspect's story.

today_in_history.fact: September 21 is celebrated globally as the International Day of Peace, established by the United Nations in 1981.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? A 'jiffy' is an actual unit of time. It is exactly 1/100th of a second.

quote_of_the_day.quote: Peace begins with a smile.
quote_of_the_day.author: Mother Teresa

paheli.question: What has one eye, but cannot see?

dialogue: Teacher: If I had seven oranges in one hand and eight oranges in the other, what would I have?
Student: Really big hands, ma'am!

prerak_kahani.title: The Golden Touch
prerak_kahani.story: King Midas wished that everything he touched would turn to gold. His wish was granted, and he turned his chair, table, and bed into gold. Thrilled, he sat down to eat, but his food turned to gold in his mouth. Then, his beloved daughter ran to hug him, and she instantly turned into a golden statue. Midas realized that wealth was meaningless without love and sustenance.
prerak_kahani.moral: Greed will always lead to downfall. Money is not the most important thing in life.

word_of_the_day.meaning: The state of being calm, peaceful, and untroubled.
word_of_the_day.example: She walked by the lake to enjoy the serenity of nature.

today_in_history.fact: On September 22, 1903, Italian immigrant Italo Marchiony was granted a patent for inventing the ice cream cone.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? Venus is the only planet in our solar system that spins clockwise on its axis.

quote_of_the_day.quote: The only real mistake is the one from which we learn nothing.
quote_of_the_day.author: Henry Ford

paheli.question: I have a head and a tail that will never meet. Having too many of me is always a treat. What am I?

dialogue: Daughter: Dad, what do you call cheese that isn't yours?
Dad: I don't know.
Daughter: Nacho cheese!

prerak_kahani.title: The Lion and the Clever Rabbit
prerak_kahani.story: A cruel lion demanded one animal a day for his meal. When it was the rabbit's turn, he arrived very late. The furious lion demanded an explanation. The rabbit said another, much bigger lion had stopped him. The rabbit led the angry lion to a deep well to show him his 'rival'. The lion saw his own reflection, roared, jumped in to attack, and drowned.
prerak_kahani.moral: Intelligence is vastly superior to physical strength.

word_of_the_day.meaning: The quality of being clever, original, and inventive.
word_of_the_day.example: He showed great ingenuity in fixing the machine with just a paperclip and rubber band.

today_in_history.fact: On September 23, 1846, the planet Neptune was discovered by astronomers calculating its position mathematically before directly observing it.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? Starfish do not have a brain. Their nervous system is spread entirely throughout their arms.

quote_of_the_day.quote: It does not matter how slowly you go as long as you do not stop.
quote_of_the_day.author: Confucius

paheli.question: The more you take, the more you leave behind. What are they?

dialogue: Friend 1: Why do seagulls fly over the sea?
Friend 2: Why?
Friend 1: Because if they flew over the bay, they'd be bagels!

prerak_kahani.title: The Blind Men and the Elephant
prerak_kahani.story: Six blind men encountered an elephant for the first time. One touched the trunk and said it was a snake. Another touched the leg and called it a tree. Another touched the tail and said it was a rope. They began to argue fiercely. A wise man passing by told them, 'You are all right. You are just feeling different parts of the same animal.'
prerak_kahani.moral: People often look at the same thing from different perspectives and see entirely different truths. Respect other people's viewpoints.

word_of_the_day.meaning: A particular attitude toward or way of regarding something; a point of view.
word_of_the_day.example: Traveling to different countries gives you a new perspective on life.

today_in_history.fact: On September 24, 2014, India's Mars Orbiter Mission (Mangalyaan) successfully entered Mars orbit on its first attempt.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? A group of flamingos is called a 'flamboyance'.

quote_of_the_day.quote: To be yourself in a world that is constantly trying to make you something else is the greatest accomplishment.
quote_of_the_day.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

paheli.question: What can travel all around the world while staying in a corner?

dialogue: Brother: Why are frogs so happy?
Sister: I don't know.
Brother: Because they eat whatever bugs them!

prerak_kahani.title: Two Frogs in the Milk
prerak_kahani.story: Two frogs accidentally fell into a deep bucket of milk. They swam for hours, trying to jump out, but the sides were too slippery. One frog said, 'It's no use,' stopped swimming, and drowned. The second frog refused to give up. He kicked and paddled so hard and for so long that the milk eventually turned into butter. He stood on the solid butter and hopped out to safety.
prerak_kahani.moral: Never give up. Persistence and hard work can turn the worst situations into solid ground.

word_of_the_day.meaning: Courage in pain or adversity.
word_of_the_day.example: She endured her illness with great fortitude.

today_in_history.fact: On September 25, 1926, Henry Ford announced the 8-hour, 5-day workweek for his factory workers, revolutionizing modern labor standards.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? An ostrich's eye is bigger than its brain.

quote_of_the_day.quote: Success is going from failure to failure without losing your enthusiasm.
quote_of_the_day.author: Winston Churchill

paheli.question: What has 13 hearts, but no lungs or stomach?
paheli.answer: A Deck of Playing Cards (Suits of Hearts)

dialogue: Patient: What did the left eye say to the right eye?
Doctor: What?
Patient: Between you and me, something smells!

prerak_kahani.title: The Bear and the Two Friends
prerak_kahani.story: Two friends were walking through a forest when a bear suddenly appeared. One man quickly climbed a tree and hid. The other, unable to fight a bear alone, threw himself on the ground and pretended to be dead. The bear sniffed his ears, lost interest, and wandered away. The friend in the tree came down and asked, 'What did the bear whisper in your ear?' The man replied, 'He told me never to trust a friend who abandons you in times of danger.'
prerak_kahani.moral: A friend in need is a friend indeed.

word_of_the_day.meaning: The quality of being exceptionally wise, having keen mental discernment and good judgment.
word_of_the_day.example: The village elder was known for his great sagacity.

today_in_history.fact: On September 26, 1969, The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road'.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? A single bolt of lightning contains enough energy to toast 100,000 slices of bread.

quote_of_the_day.quote: The mind is everything. What you think you become.
quote_of_the_day.author: Buddha

paheli.question: I am an instrument that you can hear but never see or touch. What am I?

dialogue: Son: What do you call a bear caught in the rain?
Mother: Tell me.
Son: A drizzly bear!

prerak_kahani.title: The Farmer's Hidden Treasure
prerak_kahani.story: An old, dying farmer had three lazy sons. He told them there was a great treasure buried in his fields. After he passed, the sons spent days aggressively digging up every inch of the land looking for gold, but found nothing. Frustrated, they decided to plant seeds in the freshly turned soil since the hard work was already done. Months later, they harvested an enormous crop and made a fortune. They finally understood what their father's 'treasure' meant.
prerak_kahani.moral: Hard work is the real treasure that yields great rewards.

word_of_the_day.meaning: A strong feeling of support, allegiance, or devotion.
word_of_the_day.example: The dog showed incredible loyalty by never leaving his owner's side.

today_in_history.fact: September 27 is celebrated globally as World Tourism Day, raising awareness about the role of tourism within the international community.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? The Eiffel Tower can be up to 15 centimeters (6 inches) taller during the summer due to thermal expansion of the iron.

quote_of_the_day.quote: Not all those who wander are lost.
quote_of_the_day.author: J.R.R. Tolkien

paheli.question: What can you catch but not throw?

dialogue: Kid 1: What do you call a magical dog?
Kid 2: What?
Kid 1: A labracadabrador!

prerak_kahani.title: The Brahmin and the Crooks
prerak_kahani.story: A Brahmin was carrying a plump goat on his shoulders to sacrifice. Three crooks wanted the goat for a feast. They positioned themselves along his route. The first crook asked, 'Why carry a dog?' The Brahmin ignored him. The second crook said, 'It is shameful to carry a dead calf.' The Brahmin got nervous. The third crook laughed, 'Why are you carrying a donkey?' The Brahmin, convinced his eyes were deceiving him and that he was carrying a demon, dropped the goat and ran away. The crooks had their feast.
prerak_kahani.moral: Do not be easily swayed by what others say. Trust your own judgment.

word_of_the_day.meaning: Easily persuaded to believe something; easily tricked.
word_of_the_day.example: The scammer targeted gullible people by sending fake lottery emails.

today_in_history.fact: On September 28, 1928, Scottish scientist Sir Alexander Fleming discovered penicillin, revolutionizing modern medicine.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? The shortest war in history took place between Britain and Zanzibar on August 27, 1896. Zanzibar surrendered after 38 minutes.

quote_of_the_day.quote: Genius is one percent inspiration and ninety-nine percent perspiration.
quote_of_the_day.author: Thomas Edison

paheli.question: What has legs, but doesn't walk?

dialogue: Student: Why do we tell actors to 'break a leg'?
Drama Teacher: Because every play has a cast!

prerak_kahani.title: The Echo of Life
prerak_kahani.story: A little boy got angry with his mother and shouted into a valley, 'I hate you, I hate you!' The mountain echoed back, 'I hate you, I hate you!' Terrified, he ran to his mother and told her there was a bad boy in the mountain. She smiled and told him to yell, 'I love you.' He did, and the valley echoed back, 'I love you, I love you.'
prerak_kahani.moral: Life is an echo. What you send out, comes back. What you sow, you reap.

word_of_the_day.meaning: The principle of cause and effect where intent and actions of an individual influence their future.
word_of_the_day.example: He believed in karma, knowing that his good deeds would eventually return to him.

today_in_history.fact: September 29 is celebrated annually as World Heart Day to raise awareness about cardiovascular disease.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? Cats have five toes on their front paws, but only four on their back paws.

quote_of_the_day.quote: Your time is limited, so don't waste it living someone else's life.
quote_of_the_day.author: Steve Jobs

paheli.question: What ancient invention allows people to see right through a wall?

dialogue: Customer: Waiter, will my pizza be long?
Waiter: No sir, it will be round.

prerak_kahani.title: The Cracked Pot
prerak_kahani.story: A water bearer had two large pots. One had a crack in it and always arrived half full, while the other was perfect. The cracked pot felt ashamed of its imperfection. One day, the bearer told the pot, 'Notice how there are flowers only on your side of the path? I knew about your flaw, so I planted seeds there. Every day, you watered them. Without you being just the way you are, this beauty would not exist.'
prerak_kahani.moral: We all have our own unique flaws, but those cracks and flaws can create something beautiful.

word_of_the_day.meaning: The quality of being open, honest, and straightforward in expression.
word_of_the_day.example: I appreciate your candor when discussing the difficulties of this project.

today_in_history.fact: On September 30, 1452, the first section of the Gutenberg Bible was successfully published, marking the beginning of the printing revolution.

did_you_know.fact: Did you know? There is enough gold in the core of the Earth to cover its entire surface in 1.5 feet of the shiny metal.

quote_of_the_day.quote: The unexamined life is not worth living.
quote_of_the_day.author: Socrates
